text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.
BARLEY SALE - Iran on Wednesday bought 50,000 tonnes of barley at around $125/tonne, European grain traders said. The grain is to be shipped in October.
CORN/SOY SALE - State-owned Taiwan Sugar Corp bought a combined shipment of 20,000 tonnes U.S. corn and 10,000 of U.S. soybeans from Continental at a tender on Wednesday.
CORN SALE - The Taichung division of Taiwan's Breakfast Soybean Procurement Association bought two 56,000-tonne shipments of U.S. soybeans at a tender on Wednesday.
WHEAT SALES - Iran bought 800,000 tonnes of milling wheat from the Canadian Wheat Board at US$135 FOB St. Lawrence for shipment between September and December, trade sources said.
- The CCC said it bought 30,000 tonnes of U.S. soft white wheat under its export program for donation to Pakistan.
Shipment period was slated for November 1-30.
- Morocco overnight bought 90,000 tonnes of soft wheat for September delivery, European grain traders said. The wheat is due to be delivered from September 7 to September 15.
CORN TENDERS - Taiwan's CK group will tender on Thursday for 54,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 corn, traders said.
- Taiwan grain buyers might issue a tender for 108,000 tonnes of U.S. corn in two weeks, following Tuesday's rally on Chicago corn futures amid uncertainties over market direction, traders said.

- South Africa's North-West Co-operative Ltd said it would offer for export 34,650 tonnes of yellow maize grade YM1 with an option to deliver up to 20 percent of YM2 grade. Tenders closed on August 15.
WHEAT TENDERS - The CCC said it was seeking on August 12, up to 30,000 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better soft white wheat for donation to Pakistan. Shipment period was slated for Nov 1-30.
- The CCC was seeking up to 7,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 or better Northern Spring/Dark Northern spring wheat under its export program for donation to Nicaragua.
Offers were due on August 21.

VEGOIL TENDERS - El Salvador was seeking approximately 4,000 to 5,000 tonnes prime bleachable summer yellow (PBSY) cottonseed oil in bulk and about 750 to 1,500 tonnes sunflowerseed oil under the PL-480, Title 1 export program, its U.S. export agent said. Both commodities were slated for October 1-15 shipment. Offers were due on August 14.

- Egypt's official Holding Company for Food Industries was seeking on August 19 10,000 to 20,000 tonnes of crude sunflower and/or semi-refined cottonseed oil for delivery in the second half of September.

VEGOILS - CCC will tender on August 18 to buy 3,945 tonnes of refined sunflowerseed oil for donation to Bosnia and Georgia. CCC seeks 2,695 tonnes of sunoil for Georgia and 1,250 tonnes of sunoil for Bosnia. Shipment periods for both parcels are identical, with dates of Oct 6-20 for suppliers with inland plants or Oct 19-Nov 3 for suppliers with plants at ports.

RICE TENDER - Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation forChemicals and Foodstuffs issued a tender to buy 12,000 tonnes of white rice for August delivery. September 1 was set as final date to receive bids. Results would be on Sept 8.

MARKET TALK - The European Union has organised a shipment of10,000 tonnes of rice to North Korea as famine relief, officials said on Wednesday. A tender to buy another 20,000 tonnes of rice from the market for delivery to North Korea could be launched later, they said, but no details were available. The first shipment will be delivered by October as part of a relief effort organised by the United Nations' World Food Programme, officials said. The rice was bought in a tender on the WFP's behalf by the European Commission but details of the purchase have not been released.
... The European Union accepted bids to supply 24,000 tonnes of old crop maize to North Korea as food aid, European Commission said.
... The Indian government said it has authorized the State Trading Corp and the Project and Equipment Corp to import wheat in bulk for supply to roller flour mills.
